text:
Zara (People Ops): Heads-up — new auditor request + policy change. For this attestation cycle we need two extra items in addition to the usual SOC2/ISO artifacts: 1) a manager-signed attestation form for teams that handle customer data, and 2) proof of completion of the annual privacy/security micro-training (certs). New hard cut: Mon 06/05 18:00 PT. Please read required naming + FAQ below.

Ken (Security): Important: auditors want the manager attestation to explicitly state who has access to production secrets and whether any service accounts are shared. Use the template on the compliance page.

Louise (Training): Training certs — we need the certificate PDF (or screenshot) and the learner ID. If you completed via the LMS, export the certificate and include learner id in the filename. If you completed via manager-led session, upload the signed attestation + session roster.

Zara (People Ops): New filename convention (automation will validate EXACTLY):
```
<YYYYMMDD>_<team>_<control_or_doc>_<extra>.ext
examples:
20260605_eng_access_export_certified.csv
20260605_legal_vendor_packet_attest.pdf
20260605_peopleops_training_cert_louise.pdf
```
Suffixes we recognize: _attest (manager attestation), _cert (training certificate), _prov (provisional). Fill the uploader fields: control id, owner email, production=true/false, doc_type=attest/cert/evidence. Uploader: https://go.redwood.company/evidence-and-attestations

Pat (Eng): Quick Q  for manager-signed attestations, is an emailed PDF with signature OK or does it need DocuSign?

Nora (Legal): Emailed PDF signed by manager is acceptable for now. If the auditor requests formally signed e-docs we will notify affected teams. Make sure the manager's role and email are visible on the document.

Ken (Security): For access exports: CSV + one-line query + export timestamp still preferred. If the export is older than 30 days, include a short note explaining why and provide current snapshot as well. Auditors flagged stale exports previously.

Louise (Training): If someone completed training but lost the cert, the LMS can reissue. Contact training-support@redwood.company and include your employee id. We can fast-track reissues for attestation windows.

attest_bot: Reminder scheduled — "Evidence + attestations due Mon 06/05 18:00 PT". Will post in #people-ops and DM owners at 09:00 PT on due day.

Zara (People Ops): Office hours this round: Fri 08:30-10:00 PT (attest help), Mon 12:00-14:00 PT (last-minute uploads). Booking links on the compliance page. We'll slot 10-min manager-attestation reviews by appointment.

Pat (Eng): For vendor questionnaires where procurement is delayed, can we upload a manager attestation that vendor data access is limited pending final packet?

Nora (Legal): Manager attestation can be used as provisional evidence for small-scope vendors, but procurement must still file the vendor packet as soon as possible. Mark such uploads with _prov and set doc_type=attest.

Ken (Security): Redaction policy reminder: redact PII/credentials before upload. If redactions are applied, include one-line redaction summary in README. If you redact secrets, note the field names but NOT the values.

Zara (People Ops): Automation notes: 1) filename pattern must match exactly including underscores, 2) zipped bundles must be flat and README.txt must be at the zip root, 3) training_cert files should include learner id in the filename or in README. Mismatches cause auto-reject.

Louise (Training): We'll run a quick cert reissue drop-in Tue 09:00-11:00 PT for folks who need last-minute certs. Sign up on the training page.

Pat (Eng): I'll coordinate with my manager for the attestations and aim to upload Tue EOD.

Zara (People Ops): One more process item: if you miss the deadline we will accept late items but they will be processed as exceptions which triggers additional review and may delay team attestation. If stuck, DM me or ping #compliance-help. Thanks all :pray:
